name: Confronting
overview: Scripture teaches that confronting others, especially in matters of sin, should be done with wisdom, gentleness, and love. A soft answer can defuse anger, and wise restraint is encouraged over impulsive speech, as seen in Proverbs 15:1 and 29:11. Jesus instructs believers to address faults privately to restore relationships (Matthew 18:15), while Galatians 6:1 emphasizes restoring others with meekness and self-awareness to avoid temptation. Speaking truth in love and honesty is essential for the growth and unity of the body of Christ (Ephesians 4:15, 25).
